cases.summary: Release flow composes sleep/never-active P302 stage with P303 native AI and human approval, verifies exact saved Perchance release and selected GitHub provenance, publishes only with confirmed listing, atomically adopts MANAGED/SLEEPING with no immediate active allocation.

Active READY source waits without writes; verified unlisting precedes update save, P102 validates approved bytes and P104 conditionally commits PJS+HTML atomically against exact main HEAD/expected blobs; intervening changes stop writeback and unchanged source avoids loops.

Covers first and subsequent staging, public/unlisted ordering, deterministic CAS conflict and uncertainty, safe rollback/quarantine, restart after confirmed GitHub writeback, uncertain publication readback without replay, stale binding, malformed source, and P204 source-baseline adoption.
